text:
Oh, hello!
Are you new here?
zh:
哦，你好！
你是新来的吗？

text:
Hey!
Do you need something?
zh:
嘿！
你需要什么吗？

text: I am Cedric, the newest mage of the academy.
zh: 我是塞德里克，学院最新晋的法师。

text: I want to join the academy.
zh: 我想加入学院。

text: How did you join the academy?
zh: 你是怎么加入学院的？

text: Can you help me become a mage of the academy?
zh: 你能帮我成为学院的法师吗？

text: Regarding the wine problem...
zh: 关于葡萄酒的问题……

text: I found the dealer of the fake wines.
zh: 我找到卖假酒的人了。

text: Where do I get magic equipment?
zh: 我在哪里能弄到魔法装备？

text: Here is the list of your customers.
zh: 这是你的客户名单。

text: Show me your wares.
zh: 让我看看你的货。

text: See you.
zh: 回头见。

text:
I was lucky enough to help Warak and Lyrak on a secret mission.
In the end, Warak was happy to accepted me into the ranks of the mages.
zh:
我有幸帮瓦拉克和莱拉克完成了一项秘密任务。
最后，瓦拉克很乐意地接纳我加入了法师的行列。

text:
The easiest way to join is to have rich parents.
Many of our novices were sent by their parents to one day become a mage.
zh:
最省事的入门办法，就是有个有钱的爹娘。
我们许多见习生都是被父母送来的，指望着有朝一日能成为法师。

text: But most of them don't understand our ways. Ultimately, the majority stay novices their whole life and keep on making our wine or clean our rooms.
zh: 可他们大多不懂我们的门道。到头来，大部分人一辈子都只是见习生，一直在替我们酿酒、打扫房间。

text:
I am not supposed to say that, right?
Anyway, please don't mention it towards our novices.
zh:
这些话我本不该说的，对吧？
总之，请别在见习生面前提起。

text:
The rightful way, however, is to gain our trust.
We mages usually reward anyone who helps us.
zh:
不过，正途还是赢得我们的信任。
我们法师通常会报答帮助过我们的人。

text:
At first, I thought that I had to talk to our elder when I joined, but it appears that he is a busy man.
It's a shame I never saw him in person.
zh:
起初我以为入会时得去拜见我们的长老，但他似乎是个大忙人。
可惜我从没亲眼见过他。

text: Although I have only recently become a magician, I believe that my word has some influence among the other mages.
zh: 虽然我才刚成为法师不久，但我相信我的话在其他法师中还是有些分量的。

text:
Hmm...
There's a problem I need help with.
zh:
唔……
有个问题我需要人帮忙。

text: If you help me, I'll put in a good word for you with Warak.
zh: 如果你肯帮我，我就在瓦拉克面前替你美言几句。

text: I'll help you. What's the problem?
zh: 我来帮你。是什么问题？

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text:
Of course.
Ideally, the problem solves itself.
zh:
当然。
最好这问题能自己解决。

text: The thing is, I'm responsible for the distribution of our wine and I also take care of the finances.
zh: 是这样的，我负责我们葡萄酒的分销，同时也管着账目。

text: Recently, demand has declined, although according to some, consumption of our wine continued to rise.
zh: 最近，订货量下降了，可据一些人说，我们葡萄酒的消耗量却还在上涨。

text: The innkeepers say that they only serve wine from the academy.
zh: 旅店老板们都说，他们只供应学院的葡萄酒。

text: If you ask me, someone is secretly selling wine to the innkeepers in our name and is collecting our gold in return.
zh: 要我说，是有人打着我们的名号偷偷向旅店老板卖酒，把本属于我们的金币装进了自己腰包。

text: Who usually buys wine from the academy?
zh: 通常都有谁向学院买酒？

text: What should I look for?
zh: 我该从哪儿查起？

text: I am on my way.
zh: 我这就去。

text:
That's the next problem. Apparently, my list of customers was stolen.
But I know most of them anyway.
zh:
这就是下一个问题了。我的客户名单似乎被偷了。
不过大多数客户我反正都记得。

text: Among the innkeepers there is Rair, the owner of the Crossroad Inn, as well as the innkeeper in the capital.
zh: 旅店老板里有十字路旅店的老板莱尔，还有王都的旅店老板。

text:
However, the innkeeper in the capital doesn't buy the wine himself, so I don't know his name.
Baron Frestek - he owns the tavern - manages the business.
zh:
不过王都的旅店老板不亲自买酒，所以我不知道他的名字。
酒馆归弗雷斯泰克男爵所有——生意也是他在打理。

text: Then there is the farmer Roland, with whom we regularly barter.
zh: 然后是农夫罗兰，我们经常和他以物易物。

text: Sometimes the quartermaster of the royal guards also buys a few boxes of wine.
zh: 有时皇家卫队的军需官也会买上几箱酒。

text: Well, and there are also a few other citizens who buy bottles here when they visit the academy.
zh: 嗯，还有一些市民造访学院时会顺便买上几瓶。

text:
To be honest. I don't know.
Talk to the innkeepers.
zh:
老实说，我也不知道。
去和旅店老板们谈谈吧。

text: They have to get the wine from somewhere, right?
zh: 他们的酒总得有个来路，对吧？

text:
Sure!
I'll be here if you need something.
zh:
好！
有需要的话，我就在这里。

text: Yes?
zh: 什么事？

text: What should I look for?
zh: 我该从哪儿查起？

text: What do you think of this wine? (Show Royal Ember)
zh: 你觉得这瓶酒怎么样？（出示皇家余烬）

text: What do you think of this wine? (Show Regis Vitae)
zh: 你觉得这瓶酒怎么样？（出示王命之典）

text: I found this list in the cellar of the barracks.
zh: 我在兵营的地窖里找到了这份名单。

text: I'll be back later.
zh: 我稍后再来。

text: I'll be here if you need something.
zh: 有需要的话，我就在这里。

text: To be honest. I don't know.
zh: 老实说，我也不知道。

text:
Start by talking to Rair, the owner of the Crossroad Inn, or the innkeeper in the capital.
Both of them sell our Academy wine.
zh:
先去找十字路旅店的老板莱尔，或者王都的旅店老板谈谈。
他们俩都卖我们学院的酒。

text: Let me see...
zh: 让我看看……

text: The label appears to be correct. The cork is sealed with red wax, the same wax we use at the Academy.
zh: 标签看起来没问题。软木塞用红蜡封着，和我们学院用的是同一种蜡。

text:
The color is simply gorgeous.
This certainly is one of the best wines the academy has ever crafted.
zh:
这色泽真是绝了。
这无疑是学院酿造过的最好的葡萄酒之一。

text:
Here, take back this excellent bottle of wine.
I'm convinced this isn't a fake.
zh:
来，这瓶好酒你拿回去吧。
我确信这不是假货。

text: Let me see...
zh: 让我看看……

text:
A Regis Vitae?
And the first edition, too?!
zh:
王命之典？
还是初版的？！

text:
A bottle of Regis Vitae is worth a fortune.
I heard that the elder of the Academy himself was involved in its production.
zh:
一瓶王命之典可值一大笔钱。
听说学院的长老都亲自参与了它的酿造。

text: You would have been set for life if it weren't for this flaw right here.
zh: 要不是这里有这么个破绽，你后半辈子都吃穿不愁了。

text: Although the wine is said to have a honey note, the Regis Vitae, like every other wine from the Academy, was made exclusively with our grapes.
zh: 虽说这酒号称带有蜂蜜的香气，但王命之典和学院所有其他葡萄酒一样，都只用我们自己的葡萄酿造。

text:
Also, the red wax above the cork is different from the one we use.
This is easy to see when the sun shines on the wax at a certain angle.
zh:
还有，软木塞上的红蜡也和我们用的不一样。
阳光以特定角度照在蜡上时，很容易看出来。

text:
This wine is obviously a fake.
Where did you get this bottle from?
zh:
这瓶酒显然是假货。
你这瓶是从哪儿弄来的？

text: From the innkeeper of the capital.
zh: 从王都的旅店老板那里。

text:
Then we have a lead.
Find out where the bottle came from, and we'll soon find the counterfeiter.
zh:
那我们就有线索了。
查清这瓶酒的来路，很快就能找到造假的人。

text: Here, take back the fake bottle in case you need it later.
zh: 来，这瓶假酒你先拿回去，以后也许用得上。

text: This label, however, indicates that honey was added.
zh: 但这标签上却写着添加了蜂蜜。

text:
That's great!
Speak! Who's behind this?
zh:
太好了！
快说！幕后黑手是谁？

text: Marvin. He took care of some deliveries.
zh: 是马文。他负责过几次送货。

text:
Marvin? I know him.
He handled the latest of Frestek's orders for the tavern, right?
zh:
马文？我认识他。
弗雷斯泰克酒馆最近几批订单就是他经手的，对吧？

text: So it was he who was able to smuggle the fake wines into the orders.
zh: 这么说，就是他趁机把假酒混进了订单里。

text: And it was he who must have stolen the list of my customers.
zh: 而且偷走我客户名单的肯定也是他。

text: Where is Marvin now?
zh: 马文现在人在哪儿？

text: He is still in the capital.
zh: 他还在王都。

text: He was able to flee.
zh: 他逃走了。

text: We will make sure that he receives his punishment.
zh: 我们会确保他受到应有的惩罚。

text:
That's unfortunate!
Well, at least we know his face.
zh:
真遗憾！
好在我们至少认得他的脸。

text: If Marvin participates in another delivery here, we will immediately identify and arrest him.
zh: 要是马文再敢参与来这里的送货，我们会立刻认出他并将他逮捕。

text:
And now to you.
You helped us a lot in solving the case.
zh:
现在说说你。
这桩案子多亏了你的帮忙。

text: I'll put in a good word for you with Warak.
zh: 我会在瓦拉克面前替你美言几句。

text: Besides the wine business, I also deal in magical artifacts.
zh: 除了葡萄酒生意，我还经营魔法器物。

text:
But those wares are strictly for members of the Academy.
We've had enough disasters already.
zh:
但那些货只卖给学院成员。
我们经历的灾祸已经够多了。

text: Take a look.
zh: 看看吧。

text: I see... So this is where my list ended up.
zh: 原来如此……我的名单竟然流落到了这里。

text: I shall take the list back into my possession.
zh: 这份名单我要收回了。

text:
This suggests that someone from the Guard stole it.
Most likely during one of the recent deliveries.
zh:
这说明是卫队里的人偷的。
多半是趁最近某次送货的时候。

text:
You should consult the quartermaster at the barracks.
He usually arranges the wine deliveries for the capital.
zh:
你该去问问兵营的军需官。
王都的葡萄酒配送通常都由他安排。

text:
You should consult the quartermaster at the barracks.
He usually arranges the wine deliveries for the capital.
zh:
你该去问问兵营的军需官。
王都的葡萄酒配送通常都由他安排。

text:
Thank you so much!
I'll keep an eye on that list this time.
zh:
太感谢你了！
这次我一定看好这份名单。
